import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int round = Integer.parseInt(scanner.nextLine());
        String[] firstPersonInput = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        String[] secondPersonInput = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        List<Integer> firstPerson = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> secondPerson = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String s : firstPersonInput) {
            firstPerson.add(Integer.parseInt(s));
        }
        for (String s : secondPersonInput) {
            secondPerson.add(Integer.parseInt(s));
        }
        solve(round, firstPerson, secondPerson);
        scanner.close();
    }

    public static void solve(int r, List<Integer> fp, List<Integer> sp) {
        int totalWin = 0;
        List<Integer> spExtended = new ArrayList<>(sp);
        spExtended.add(sp.get(0));
        for (int i = 0; i < fp.size(); i++) {
            totalWin += Math.min(fp.get(i), spExtended.get(i + 1));
        }
        // Remove last element and insert the third element at the beginning
        sp.remove(sp.size() - 1);
        sp.add(0, sp.get(2));
        for (int i = 0; i < fp.size(); i++) {
            if (fp.get(i) > 0) {
                int diff = Math.min(fp.get(i), sp.get(i));
                fp.set(i, fp.get(i) - diff);
                sp.set(i, sp.get(i) - diff);
                if (fp.get(i) > 0) {
                    int diff2 = Math.min(fp.get(i), sp.get(i + 1));
                    fp.set(i, fp.get(i) - diff2);
                    sp.set(i + 1, sp.get(i + 1) - diff2);
                }
            }
        }
        int sumFp = 0;
        for (int val : fp) {
            sumFp += val;
        }
        System.out.println(sumFp + " " + totalWin);
    }
}
